translations.en:
One of the oldest dragon
species, and one rarely
seen. Because encounters
are so uncommon, little
information exists and rumors
have outpaced the facts.

Some say it has survived since ancient
times, so it seems unlikely to be weak.
Still, there is reason to question
whether its reputation is exaggerated.

translations.en:
A monster classified
among the undead.

Said to be made from the body
of a child unfortunate enough
to have left this world. Though
physically weak, it can inflict
great harm on anyone who
underestimates its speed.

translations.en:
Staring at its grotesque
appearance can cause almost
physical discomfort. Like orcs,
it is a demi-human, but even
greedier by nature. It seems
particularly drawn to shiny
objects. Anyone other than an
adventurer might escape by
using valuables as bait.
Adventurers who flee by
sacrificing their valuables
should remember why they became
adventurers in the first place.

translations.en:
A member of the fairy race.
Like other fairies, it is
capricious, but it seems to
differ in having a strong
individual desire to show off.

Many reports tell of
adventurers who followed
one deep into a labyrinth
and never returned. This
has led to speculation
that it possesses a
power of enchantment.

translations.en:
A kind of fairy, like pixies
and trolls. Keenly interested
in humans, it often appears
near villages, where it has
reportedly been seen imitating
the work of tilling fields.

From that alone, it sounds
endearing. Adventurers, however,
describe it as a slow-footed,
rough-mannered plunderer.

It appears to possess the heart and
intelligence to change its behavior
according to the human it encounters.

translations.en:
A monster said to exist
in mountains and mines.
Its disposition is so
peaceful that some doubt
it could survive in a
dangerous labyrinth, and
question whether it is
really there at all. If you
happen to meet one amid
your endless battles, by
all means treat it gently.

translations.en:
A slime-like monster that
serves as the labyrinth's
scavenger. Slime creatures
are usually slow, but this
one becomes extremely quick
only when attacking, extending
and retracting its tentacles
at blinding speed.

It moves just as slowly as other
slimes, yet the unexpected speed
of its tentacles has apparently
injured many adventurers.

translations.en:
Recorded as a demon drawn forth
and manifested through summoning
rituals or summoning gates.

Ancient writings single out
its ability to summon its
own past and future selves
to its present self, but
apparently no one has
confirmed such an event.

The latest information is
an extremely vague report
stating that being enveloped
in blue mist is hopeless.

translations.en:
A high-ranking demon. Its
attacks exploit weaknesses
in the heart and can kill
even thoroughly trained
adventurers in an instant.
However, most of its abilities
are sealed, preventing it from
unleashing its true power.

Those who have seen its
true form lose their
sanity even if they
survive, leaving no reliable
information about it.

translations.en:
Few people could truly
grasp what malicious
air means, but this
monster makes that
sensation tangible.

The truth awaits investigation.
One leading theory is that it was
an elemental that became a demon.

The sight of a being combining an elemental's
power with a demon's menace will surely
leave anyone who encounters it speechless.

translations.en:
A giant that governs thunder.

Believed to carry
the blood of the
Odin clan, once the
most powerful group
among the giants.

Besides possessing knowledge
beyond humans and highly advanced
magical techniques, it also has
the enormous body and attack power
characteristic of giants. A
difficult battle is inevitable.

translations.en:
Skilled at surviving the harshest
environments, these people
regard adventurers as no more
than another kind of prey.
They favor long-range weapons
and sometimes launch direct
attacks on the back row.

Neglect the back row's defense,
and the front row will be wiped
out next. That is so basic it
scarcely needs to be written here.

translations.en:
A renowned Kensei wandering
in pursuit of greater
swordsmanship... That
sounds admirable enough.

In truth, a Kensei consumed
by the sword and obsessed
only with cutting people
down becomes a terrifying
enemy beyond all persuasion.
When confronting one who
silently readies a blade,
adventurers should be
prepared even for death.

translations.en:
A spirit that protects
the forest. Naturally,
it retaliates when the
forest is attacked. Its
retaliation apparently
falls on everyone it sees,
regardless of whether
they were responsible.

Consumed by anger, it
will not listen to
attempts at persuasion.

translations.en:
In certain regions, this
monster features in
warnings used to discipline
children. Those actually
encountered in labyrinths
are cruel bands of
murderers far worse than
any ogre from a fairy
tale. Remember that
their comical appearance
is only a deception.

translations.en:
A tree that roams the
labyrinth through sorcery.
Its hollows may resemble
a face, but apparently
do not function as one.

It uses its roots to turn captured
prey into nourishment. In the end,
it is only a tree and is slow and
ponderous. A patient battle
should present no great problem.

translations.en:
Swords controlled by magic
fly in swarms, drawing the
swords of their slain victims
into their own ranks.

Floating in the air and
difficult to strike, they are
troublesome enemies. However,
valuable blades sometimes
lie among them, so many
adventurers actively hunt the
swarms. Many others, however,
end up contributing their
own swords to the group.

translations.en:
A pitiful witch transformed
into a monster. Shiin's love
grew distorted, and the
pursuit of a forbidden wish
led an evil serpent to possess
her. Feeding on the dark
lust buried deep in her
heart, the serpent multiplied
within her body in an
instant, leaving masses of
serpentine bodies exposed.
translations.note: The source explicitly calls the transformed figure a witch, supporting female pronouns; the relation to Shiin is retained without importing external plot assumptions.

translations.en:
Said to be the form of a ruler
whose ambition and inner darkness
grew until they absorbed a
dragon, allowing dark power to
dominate both body and mind.

An incarnation of the desire for
destruction, this being believes
the entire world belongs to
them and has no intention of
sharing it with anyone. It is
said to destroy the world in
order to make it theirs alone.

translations.en:
The form gained by sacrificing
body and soul to the inhuman gods
in which this being believes.

It bears the wings of an accursed
crow. In its four hands it carries
enormous cleavers, dispensing
punishment on behalf of the chaos
it worships to anyone who would
uphold order. It dreams of creating
a world consumed by chaos.
